faq.question: How long does printing and delivery take?
faq.answer: In-stock products are packed and delivered within 24–48 business hours. Custom print orders have a production time that depends on complexity, quoted specifically during the quoting step (within 30 minutes of sending your file).

faq.question: Is my 3D design file kept confidential?
faq.answer: Your .stl/.step/.obj/.3mf file is only used to quote and produce your own order — never for any other purpose, and never shared with third parties. See our 3D design file confidentiality policy for details.

faq.question: Which material fits my needs?
faq.answer: PLA is great for highly detailed decorative models, PETG is durable and impact-resistant for everyday-use accessories, and Resin gives extremely fine detail and a smooth finish. See the full comparison in the Materials section above.

faq.question: How can I pay, and what's your return policy?
faq.answer: We support cash on delivery (COD) or bank transfer before production. Products with production defects or delivered incorrectly can be exchanged/returned within 7 days of receipt; custom print orders that match the approved file and quote are not eligible for return.

faq.question: Can't find what you need in the product catalog?
faq.answer: Send your design file or describe your idea via the Custom Print page — our technical team will recommend materials and quote your order individually.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: When you place an order or submit a custom print request at {siteName}, we collect: full name, phone number, email (if provided), delivery address, and the design content/files you submit with your request. We don't require an account — every order/request is handled independently.
privacy.section2Item1: To contact you for consultation, quoting, and order confirmation
privacy.section2Item2: To produce and deliver exactly what you requested
privacy.section3Body: We never sell or share your personal information with third parties, other than what's necessary for delivery (our shipping partners) and the technical infrastructure services required to run this website.
privacy.section4Body: For any questions about this privacy policy, contact us via Zalo/hotline: {hotline}.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.section1Body: {siteName} supports cash on delivery (COD) and bank transfer before production. Custom print orders only go into production after the customer accepts the quote.
shipping.section2Item1: In-stock products: packed and delivered within 24–48 business hours
shipping.section2Item2: Custom print orders: production time depends on complexity, and is quoted specifically during the quoting step
shipping.section3Body: We deliver nationwide through partner shipping carriers. Shipping fees are shown clearly before you confirm your order.
shipping.section4Body: To track an order or ask about delivery, contact us via Zalo/hotline: {hotline}.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.section1Body: Products can be exchanged/returned within 7 days of receipt if: the product has a production defect (cracked, broken, printed at the wrong size/color versus the confirmed order), or the wrong product was delivered.
returns.section2Item1: Custom print orders that match the file/specifications you provided and that you already approved the quote for
returns.section2Item2: Damage from use or impact after you've received the product
returns.section3Body: Contact us via Zalo/hotline: {hotline} with photos/video of the defective product within 7 days for a return or refund.

fileConfidentiality.metaDescription: Our commitment to keeping your 3D design files (STL/STEP/OBJ/3MF) confidential when you submit a custom print request.
fileConfidentiality.title: 3D Design File Confidentiality Policy
fileConfidentiality.section1BodyBefore: Design files (.stl, .step/.stp, .obj, .3mf) or reference images you submit via the
fileConfidentiality.section1BodyAfter: page are used by {siteName} only for quoting and producing your own order. We never use customer design files for any other commercial purpose, never resell them, and never share them with third parties beyond what's necessary to print your product.
fileConfidentiality.section2Body: Files are stored on {siteName}'s own private cloud infrastructure, accessible only to the technical team handling your order. Files are never previewed automatically — staff only open them manually when needed to quote or produce your order.
fileConfidentiality.section3Body: If you'd like to request deletion of a design file you submitted after your order is complete, contact us via Zalo/hotline: {hotline}.
fileConfidentiality.section4BodyBefore: You confirm you hold the legal rights to any design file you send us for production.
fileConfidentiality.section4BodyAfter: is not responsible if a file provided by a customer infringes a third party's intellectual property rights.
